criteria.name: Research design
criteria.guidance: State the question with its variables and enough method to repeat.

criteria.guidance: Record, process and present data so a conclusion can be drawn, uncertainties included.

criteria.name: Conclusion
criteria.guidance: Answer your own question against the analysis and published science, uncertainties included.

criteria.guidance: Name the specific weaknesses that mattered most and improvements that address them.
